reviews.text: Our favourite corner spot after the school run. Lovely staff, dog-friendly and the cheddar toastie is brilliant.

about: Brackenbury Corner Coffee is a small, dog-friendly neighbourhood café on a quiet residential corner in Hammersmith. We keep things simple: great coffee, warm pastries and crisp sourdough toasties.
